args.summary:
Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island: Biscoe 38.38, Dream 39.39, Torgersen 39.13 (21 Adelie rows used).

Data problems found and fixed:
- Species label variants: " Adelie" (leading space) and misspelling "Chinstarp" were merged into the allowed labels "Adelie" and "Chinstrap" via normalize_labels — this mattered because the " Adelie" row would otherwise have been excluded from the Adelie averages.
- One exact duplicate row (row 28) was removed so it wouldn't double-count in the means.

Checks performed: bill_length_mm is fully numeric, no missing values, and all values fall within the rules-file range [30, 60]; island labels are clean (Biscoe/Dream/Torgersen only).

Issues noted but not fixed (not used by this question): flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values (out of range) and body_mass_g has an extreme max (3,500,000 g, far above the 6,500 g rule); sex has 1 missing value (rules say leave unknown).
